description: Delete one Proactive Messages rule. The chatbot stops sending that message on the next page a visitor opens. The message log keeps the past entries. To pause a rule instead, use save_proactive_message with enabled false.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule, from list_proactive_messages.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: delete_proactive_message
title: Delete a Proactive Messages rule
